title: Fourier Drawing Machine
prompt: Build an interactive Fourier epicycle drawing machine in p5.js using function sketch(p, ctx). Let the user draw any closed shape, resample it uniformly by arc length, compute its discrete Fourier transform in code, then animate rotating epicycles reconstructing the path. Provide keyboard toggles for x/y separate chains versus one complex chain, frequency order versus amplitude order, and showing the original stroke. Expose sampleCount, epicycleCount, playbackSpeed, trailLength, lineWeight, and smoothingPasses through ctx.params. Display reconstruction error and ensure a new drawing cleanly replaces all previous coefficients.
